title: Base overlays: a per-test or FAIL-lines-only revert command, and a short sample of real go vet type-error output

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Split from S594 (Jon chose 'Closure + gate, revert named tests', session 8d711f67, 2026-11-27). Carries S640 (overlay commands run a whole package, internal/engine/baseoverlay.go:146; give a per-test revert command or a form that prints only FAIL lines) and adj 632 (in Base overlays, include a short sample of real go vet type-error output for one changed file so reviewers can confirm vet path forms without a probe overlay).
